sources.title: SAIACS CEO Centre — Conference & Events
sources.reviewNote: Seminar & Conference Halls table (Hall | Cluster Style | Theatre Style): Mysore 40 | 60, Rudra 50 | 70, Joel 40 | 50, Jacaranda 60 | 100; every hall includes audio systems, projection facilities and writing boards. “Ground Event Area: Suitable for gatherings of up to 500 guests.” The Caleb Auditorium seats “approximately 350 guests” with no stated layout.

sources.title: SAIACS institute — CEO Centre
sources.reviewNote: Parent institute page for the CEO Centre. Seminar Halls: “Cluster Seating 30–80”, “Theatre Seating Up to 100”; Open Ground: “Capacity: 400”; Caleb Auditorium: “350 Seating Capacity”. The server answered automated requests with HTTP 500 while still serving the full page.
